A '''soldier''' served in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Moff Sarne's forces|forces]] of [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]]. During the [[Battle of Kal'Shebbol|liberation]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kal'Shebbol/Legends|Kal'Shebbol]] by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] was stationed in the [[Imperial Government Complex]]. [[Death/Legends|Killed]] during the battle, the soldier's [[Blast vest/Legends|blast vest]] and [[Blast helmet/Legends|helmet]] were stolen by the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Unda Lagor]], a former prisoner.
